description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing improved performance, new language features, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies and plugins are compatible with Java 25. Fix any compilation errors or deprecation warnings introduced by the Java 25 upgrade.
tasks.summary: Upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version to 25 and Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. Build succeeded with JDK 25.0.3 and no test failures.
